text:
sarah_pm: Quick sync — kicking off PRD for Console Observability (retention + tracing UX + launch criteria). Customer asks: FinReg wants 180d retention + audit logs; Marketplace wants per-tenant tiers and cost visibility. Proposal v0: tiered retention (30/90/180), trace sampling controls per-service, span-level filters, retention cost estimator inline in the route settings. Need acceptance criteria, edge cases, and a prioritized scope for MVP.

jamal_eng: SGTM. Two quick infra Qs: do we support hot vs cold storage in v1, and do we auto-truncate data when retention is shortened?

kevin_design: I can draft UI flows. Preference: keep estimator inline in the route settings (reduce context switches). For trace UX I want a compact span list + histogram for latency. Will post mocks. :art:

alex_prod: MVP must include: 1) ability to set retention per-tenant or per-route, 2) visible effective retention in the UI, 3) cost estimator for retention changes (monthly delta), 4) trace sampling toggle and ability to search spans by tag, 5) audit events for any retention change. Export to S3 must be available but can be behind a flag. Anything beyond that is post-MVP.

riley_metrics: Metric/telemetry asks: emit events for retention_changed (who, from, to), trace_ingest_rate per-route, daily_storage_bytes per-tenant, and cost_estimate_request. We also need an alert if storage growth > 30% week-over-week during launch.

jamal_eng: Edge cases to capture: - Existing data > new retention: define policy (auto-delete vs keep + warn). - Tenants with mixed model endpoints (text/embeddings) with different storage profiles. - Export requested while retention shorter than export target. - Backfill / reindex implications for trace indices. Also API plan: add /v2/observability/settings with version header.

sarah_pm: Draft acceptance criteria (feel free to iterate):
```
AC-01: Admin can set retention at tenant and route level (30/90/180 days) via Console and API.
AC-02: Console displays effective retention with clear source (tenant default vs route override).
AC-03: Cost estimator shows monthly delta before saving changes (USD projection).
AC-04: Trace page supports sampling toggle and filtering by span tag, service, and duration.
AC-05: Audit event emitted for every retention change with actor id and diff.
AC-06: Shortening retention triggers a warning modal explaining data deletion; deletion occurs only after explicit confirmation.
AC-07: Export to S3 works for ranges within retention and surfaces errors if export window exceeds retention.
AC-08: Metrics emitted for retention_changed, trace_ingest_rate, daily_storage_bytes.
```

kevin_design: AC-06 modal copy: "Shortening retention will permanently delete data older than X days. This cannot be undone. Export first if needed." I'll add microcopy for cost estimator tooltip.

alex_prod: Suggest adding rollout constraint: retention changes go via canary to 5% tenants first, monitor errors and storage spike for 48h, then full rollout. That should be part of launch gating.

jamal_eng: Can take the API and storage lifecycle parts. Need decision on lifecycle: implement simple TTL deletion job in v1 (daily TTL), and mark cold storage as v2. That keeps scope manageable.

riley_metrics: For gating, we'll require: no >5% error increase, storage growth under 30%/week, and estimator matched actual within 25% after 7 days. Those are measurable launch gates.

sarah_pm: Prioritization proposal: Blockers for MVP: settings UI, API endpoint, audit events, TTL deletion job, cost estimator (basic). Low priority: cold storage lifecycle, archived search, complex query analytics.

kevin_design: I'll attach initial mocks to the PRD doc later today. Expect a small iteration.

jamal_eng: Note on migration: we should not auto-delete on day-0. Plan: a staged deletion job that marks candidates then deletes after 7 days with a retention-change audit entry. Saves from accidental mass deletes.

sarah_pm: Good call. Add to AC: retention deletions are soft-flagged for 7 days with an undo window.

alex_prod: Can we add a customer-facing FAQ for Marketplace customers about retention tiers and costs? Marketing can reuse it.

sarah_pm: Yes — action: @kevin_design + @alex_prod to draft FAQ and console microcopy.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: "Observability PRD kickoff" Thu 9:00 AM (Zoom). Organizer: sarah_pm.

kevin_design: +1, I'll block slides and mock review slot.

jamal_eng: I'll start an RFC for /v2/observability/settings and link infra migration notes.

riley_metrics: I'll write the gating checks as Prometheus rules and add them in the PRD acceptance test section.

sarah_pm: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate updates into the PRD doc and ping for a review tomorrow. :thumbsup:
